oracle_check.note: A haystack identical to the answer set means the dataset variant carries no distractor sessions. Retrieval precision measured on it is an upper bound, not a deployable number.

conversion_decisions.one_question_is_one_session: haystack sessions concatenated in date order under user_key=question_id; 'session' here means one user's whole history
conversion_decisions.timestamps_synthesized: per-session date plus 1 minute(s) per turn; absolute times are not real, order is
conversion_decisions.abs_subset_is_abstain: question_ids ending in _abs are LongMemEval's own abstention set (gold answer: information not enough); their has_answer flags mark near-miss evidence and are discarded
conversion_decisions.unflagged_questions_dropped: non-abstain questions with no has_answer message are dropped, not relabeled abstain, to avoid manufacturing negatives

labels_are_dataset_provenance: relevant_message_indices comes from the dataset's per-message has_answer flag, not from reading answers (Charter §3 rule 2)
